Name: Better Junimo Farm
Author: KnightShrestha
Description:
A large farm map for using with better junimo mod.

Features:
[list]
[*]Large Map
[*]28 large plots for junimo huts, location for hut and scarecrow pre-marked.
[*]Quarry at bottom right, unlocks on day 4 
[*]Stump and logs at bottom left, unlocks on day 4
[*]Large room inside cave, at the right side of farm, unlocks at day 4.
[/list]
Info:
The statue at the center of the farm is a warp interface, will transport to different side of the farm, only works on farm.

Optional:
If you install mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27359?tab=description]Buildings Included[/url] you will get free [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Junimo_Hut]Junimo Hut[/url] at the 1st plot.

Configuration:
Remove Fence in Days: Number of days player plays to remove fence, [i]Default 4 (opens in Spring 4 Year 1)[/i]

Status:
Work in progress, high chance of bugs.

Recommendations:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2221]Better Junimos[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29130]Better Junimos Forestry Redux[/url]﻿
[/list]Nice to have:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5382]Item Bags[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26416]Less is More - An Item Bags Config File[/url]
[/list]
